question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A local meeting of party members to select candidates, elect convention delegates, etc
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'Caucus'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** group of words** *"A local meeting of party members to select candidates, elect convention delegates, etc" represents a specific term in political gathering*s.
 
• The correct term for this description is **"Caucus".**

Therefore, the** correct answer **is:- **'caucus'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Claque: **This is a group of sycophantic followers.(चापलूस समर्थकों का एक समूह)
 
• **Clique:** This represents a small group of people, with shared interests or other features in common, who spend time together and do not readily allow others to join them. (गुट)
 
• **Caravan:** The term stands for a group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, traveling together across a desert in Asia or North Africa.(कारवां)
